post.originalText:
Is Opus 5.5 on xHigh worth 40x the cost of Low?

I gave Claude Opus 5.5 the same prompt at 4 effort levels: build a "How the Internet Works" explainer website.

⚡ Low: $0.55 · 2m 48s · 535 lines
⚖️ Medium: $4.97 · 24m 37s · 3,682 lines
🔥 High: $15.32 · 1h 42m · 5,940 lines
🚀 xHigh: $22.28 · 2h 39m · 6,216 lines

The jump from High to xHigh cost 45% more and took about an hour longer, for only 5% more code.

xHigh definitely has the most taste out of all the effort levels. I don't know if it's worth the price for such explainer sites.

sourceMaterials.text: @Davidariasfin Yeah, that’s true. That’s the reason having good design is more important than ever. Polished software is harder to come by now than ever. Everyone wants to add as many features as possible.
